scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && tsc && vite build --mode preprod && cp -r ../contract/src/managed/veilcore/keys ./dist/keys && cp -r ../contract/src/managed/veilcore/zkir ./dist/zkir
scripts.build:preview: rm -rf ./dist && tsc && vite build --mode preview && cp -r ../contract/src/managed/veilcore/keys ./dist/keys && cp -r ../contract/src/managed/veilcore/zkir ./dist/zkir
scripts.build:mainnet: rm -rf ./dist && tsc && vite build --mode mainnet && cp -r ../contract/src/managed/veilcore/keys ./dist/keys && cp -r ../contract/src/managed/veilcore/zkir ./dist/zkir
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run start
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.test: for f in src/*.test.ts src/veilcore/*.test.ts src/veilcore/chain/*.test.ts; do vitest run --maxWorkers=1 "$f" || exit 1; done
